carrier_definition.residual: Xi_Lindelof = limsup_{t -> infinity} log |zeta(1/2 + i t)| / log t
carrier_definition.closure: Xi_Lindelof = 0, equivalently |zeta(1/2 + i t)| = O_epsilon(t^epsilon) for every epsilon > 0

RH_implies_Lindelof.summary: RH implies Lindelof through standard analytic consequences of RH and Phragmen-Lindelof type bounds.
RH_implies_Lindelof.classification_impact: Lindelof is a consequence of RH, not an RH-equivalent carrier.

Lindelof_strictly_weaker.summary: No accepted theorem gives Lindelof implies RH. Closing Xi_Lindelof does not close Xi_BC or RH in the cascade.
Lindelof_strictly_weaker.non_equivalence: outside Riemann-RH Dichotomy; target-equivalent only to Lindelof itself

best_subconvexity_bound.status: best pointwise bound found in this audit; Lindelof remains open

classification.under_Riemann_RH_Dichotomy: outside scope because Lindelof is not RH-equivalent
classification.under_generalized_subconjecture_Dichotom: generalized CRCFT-TE within the Lindelof family
classification.reason: closure of Xi_Lindelof is exactly Lindelof, not RH

density_hypothesis_equivalence.Backlund_short_interval_form: equivalent to Lindelof: for every sigma > 1/2, zeros in T <= Im(s) <= T+1 and sigma <= Re(s) <= 1 grow slower than log T
density_hypothesis_equivalence.standard_density_hypothesis: recorded as Lindelof-family zero-density form; audited sources state it follows from Lindelof, and this step does not use it as an unqualified RH-equivalence
density_hypothesis_equivalence.classification_impact: density/zero-count variants remain Lindelof-subtarget carriers, not RH closure routes

retained_nogos: No claim that Lindelof is proved.
No claim that RH is proved.
No claim that Lindelof implies RH.
No weakening of RH Dichotomy, CRCFT, Bridge Impossibility, CTMT recursion, or prior no-gos.
The density hypothesis is not used as a hidden bridge to RH.
